Priya (CSM): Heads up — Orbit QBR next Thursday 9am PT. Need final slide set + 3 exec asks by Wednesday COB. I started a lightweight slide map in the folder: https://drive.redwood/orbit/qbr-map 
Diego (Solutions): I'll take the integration status + blocker list. Quick ask: can someone confirm whether the inbound webhook retry is still failing for Orbit prod? Seeing 502s yesterday.
Nina (Eng): That's on my radar. Last check we had a transient LB misroute; logs pointed to a cert rotation mismatch. I've queued a short blameless note for the slide and will attach the logs. Sample log snippet: ```text
[2024-10-29T14:22:10Z] ERROR webhook-handler: upstream connect error: certificate verify failed
```
Omar (Revops): I'll own the renewal health slide (ARR + seats + open billing items). FYI: two invoices in dispute, and a 20% seat churn risk flagged. Will add a concise ask for finance follow-up.
Priya (CSM): Thanks — can you add a 1-line recommended ask for execs? Preferably two discrete asks max.
Jen (Head of CS): For exec readout please include: (1) current next action, (2) owner, (3) ETA. Keep it high level. I'll present the ask if it's <=3 items.
Diego (Solutions): Demo plan: short walk-through of integration flow and a live retry demo. If webhook still flaky, fallback to recorded video. I'll upload video to assets/demo-retry.mp4.
Priya (CSM): Uploaded onboarding progress heatmap (assets/orbit_onboarding_heatmap.png) and a 1-slide customer sentiment summary from NPS follow-up. Note: one technical ticket is aged >14 days.
Nina (Eng): Attached minimal metrics: assets/orbit_sla_metrics.csv and the query used. SQL: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('week', ts) AS week, p95_ms FROM request_latencies WHERE customer = 'orbit' ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 8;
```
Omar (Revops): Added renewal schedule and invoice status doc: assets/orbit_renewal_tracker.xlsx. Flag: finance wants a single billing contact — @Priya can you confirm?
Priya (CSM): Confirmed: billing contact is billing@orbit.co. I'll copy them on the finance action and set an internal owner.
QBR-Reminder-Bot: Reminder: final slides due 2024-11-06 23:59 UTC.
Priya (CSM): Proposed slide ownership: onboarding & sentiment (Priya), tech/blockers & demo (Diego + Nina), renewal/finance (Omar). Any swaps?
Diego (Solutions): Ack, will finish tech slide and upload assets by Wed 18:00 PT.
Nina (Eng): Ack, will add logs + blameless note by Wed 12:00 PT.
Omar (Revops): Ack, will prepare renewal asks and include one-sentence impact to revenue.
Jen (Head of CS): Thanks team. I'll do a final exec polish Thu morning; please ping me when uploads are complete. :white_check_mark:
Priya (CSM): Great. I'll collate the deck Thu noon, produce the one-slide risk summary for execs, and post final link here. Call out: prioritize the billing follow-up and the aged ticket as the top two risks.
Diego (Solutions): Quick note — if webhook looks unstable on demo day, we should switch demo to staging and note that prod is on a mitigation plan.
Priya (CSM): Agreed. I'll add a fallback bullet in the demo notes. Thanks all.
